sources.snippet: Overview Nail-Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-GGUF is a quantized variant of Qwen's 35-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model, maintained by peculiar-ragdoll. This is Unsloth's UD-Q4_K_XL quantization of the base Qwen3.6-35B-A3B model, enhanced with an improved chat template from froggeric and a force-appended system prompt designed to reduce verbose outputs and improve reasoning speed.
